name: Rankai
long_description:
Websites used to be static billboards, passive and waiting to be found.  

RankAI helps startups and agencies grow websites on autopilot. It learns from your site, market, competitors, and performance data to identify which pages should exist, creates them in your brand, publishes them directly to your live website, and continuously improves them based on real traffic and conversion — so your website gets discovered, trusted, and converted on by both human and Agents.
one_liner: RankAI grows your website on autopilot

launches.title: Rankai – AI Agents that Replace Marketing Agencies
launches.tagline: Building AI Agents to replace marketing agencies
launches.body:
**_TL;DR:_** Rankai is building AI Agents to replace marketing agencies. Its 1st agent automates the entire SEO process and makes it 20x more affordable.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GtACzv0uiV4>

# **What’s the insight?**

Marketing agencies grew and made $400B in 2024, despite the rise of affordable marketing tools. We talked to 100+ SMB owners, and found that many would still pay thousands for marketing agencies. They want to pay for a service – for someone to think about what to do, then just execute and deliver results. 

# **What did we build?**

Rankai is building AI Agents to strategize and execute on marketing objectives, just like an agency. It’s first AI Agent automates the SEO process and makes it 20x more affordable.

How it works:

Step 1: Crawl through your website pages and understand your business.

Step 2: Suggest technical SEO fixes based on Google SEO Guide.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=85538&key=user_uploads/804786/38787d8a-f2b6-4192-a390-978a58725a1e)

Step 3: Research for target keywords tailored to the business.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfvDlVknS_1BOO7TT6rVukxlz7ROXbt8sg9mLlsqMfsV8HLNjiq-JQUS43zNtq1_98fFFygSLSg83emG0O55j8afS0CegUWoP1N2xHwxkAvaiqDxuCKmvwE9QVKISbciRQFVd0jzw?key=_60rhAaWD9CT0jrsgoEW3IYz)

Step 4: Craft keyword-optimized SEO content.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeLgTVPuUR6tTMOOeGGqoUsueqcHs_RtCr_cPyHDG4MriprwfgzlzAeCm_v5WVNkJfSXLoOoiUAlaM9fYUmvH4CrVXyJMll_LTFmhO2KcdL00vswJK5VUCnQPK0i40YjIUVIXPTCA?key=_60rhAaWD9CT0jrsgoEW3IYz)

Step 5: Finally, Rankai publish the technical SEO fixes and weekly blogs straight to your website.
